Beacon AI Centers has selected Edmonton-headquartered consulting engineering firm Stantec to design and engineer six artificial intelligence (AI) data centre campuses to meet growing capacity demand across Alberta. Specifically, Stantec will provide architectural, building engineering, sustainability, transportation, civil, environmental, geomatics and project management services for the data centres, spanning five Alberta municipalities. Each campus is projected to comprise multiple buildings across hundreds of acres. Design and permitting began in 2024 and construction is scheduled to commence this year. “By working with exceptional partners like Stantec, we can deliver ambitious projects quickly,” says Josh Schertzer, CEO of Beacon, which is backed by Nadia Partners . Advertisement “With our 70-year history in the province, we are proud to play a role in helping position Alberta as a leading global hub for data-driven AI innovation,” says Leonard Castro, executive vice-president (EVP) of buildings for Stantec, which has previously designed hyperscale, multi-tenant, greenfield, redeveloped and retrofitted data centres for regional and global operators and cloud computing providers.
